title: Runtime Reference After Placement Authority
summary: Runtime Reference selects where an already-admitted semantic operation executes; it does not replace WLU admission, allocator placement or provider containment authority.
why: Execution-location flexibility must not collapse the distinction between semantic operation identity and the authority to place or run it.
invariants: The caller keeps one semantic operation identity across local and remote execution.
Runtime binding occurs only after the relevant admission and placement requirements are satisfied.
Runtime Reference is separate from Runtime Registry and from Job-to-Node placement authority.
evidence_note: Grounded in runtime_reference_v0.4 and the placement/admittance chain documented by current managed-compute consumers.
